A '''litter''' was a group of [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] or [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] all [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] at once. The members of a litter referred to each other as "littermates." [[Rasi Tuum]] and his siblings, [[Ahn Rasi Tuum|Ahn]] and [[Zho Rasi Tuum|Zho]], were a litter. [[Lak Sivrak/Legends|Lak Sivrak]] referred to his surname as his "litter name."<ref name="Tales">{{StoryCite|story=One Last Night in the Mos Eisley Cantina: The Tale of the Wolfman and the Lamproid|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>
